- Tue Aug 31 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Sep 1 — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Sep 2 — 13:00–14:00 PT

Can you confirm which one works for your team? If none of these fit, please send 2 alternative windows and we'll do our best to align. If helpful, here is a short pre-read (attached) that explains the integration touchpoints we'll cover.

1) Integration architecture & data flows (15m)
2) Inference sizing & performance targets (15m)
3) Deployment options (Dedicated vs Private) (15m)
4) Next steps & mutual action plan (15m)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.
